caption: "case keenum" — 2,000,000+ searches this week. The Bears' third-string quarterback beat the Eagles.

Why: On Monday Night Football, September 28, Keenum, 38, started for the injured Caleb Williams and beat the Eagles 27-7: 24 of 34 for 247 yards and 3 touchdowns. It was his first start in 1,009 days. He has now won starts for 7 NFL teams. Only Ryan Fitzpatrick has done that too.

What most people don't know: he is college football's all-time passing leader, 19,217 yards at Houston, and he still isn't eligible for the College Football Hall of Fame. It requires a first-team All-America pick from a recognized selector. He never got one.
Very simply put: the Hall won't take him. Philly couldn't stop him.
